summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path, SHACLPathError) and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The 41 tests in the new module and test/test_path.py pass under the prepared interpreter. Nothing is committed. Two deviations from the spec: (1) I added an explicit non-node guard, because Graph.value(None, ...) treats None as a wildcard; (2) the arg-type type-ignore sits on the parser call line rather than the pytest.raises line. mypy, black and isort are not in the venv, so type-check and formatting were verified by reading only; a length scan confirmed no line exceeds 88 columns.
